svg.font-family: Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Times New Roman', serif
svg.title: Player Board
svg.desc: One per player, one per vehicle in play, and one spare for the table, and every one identical. The card in play top left, ten tracks up the middle, one kit card on the right with its wear and capacity ladders against it, and the round's phases under the card in play. Everything else a figure carries goes on the items board. The mana track is an arcane subject and is the only thing on the board that takes the slip. Generated by tools/build-board.mjs from data/playerboard.json and data/components.json — do not edit. 297 x 210 mm at 8 units/mm, 3 mm bleed. The ink plate alone is the black-and-white edition.
